Table

Tables present tabular data in a clean, scannable layout. Combine variants such as striped, hover, bordered, small and dark to suit your content.

Basic Table

Use .zak-table directly on the <table> element.

# Name Role Status
1Janet FoxProduct DesignerActive
2Mark KimFrontend EngineerAway
3Sara ReyesData AnalystInactive
HTML
<table class="zak-table">
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th>#</th>
      <th>Name</th>
      <th>Role</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr><td>1</td><td>Janet Fox</td><td>Product Designer</td></tr>
  </tbody>
</table>

Striped Table

Add .zak-table-striped for alternating row backgrounds.

InvoiceClientAmountDate
#1024Acme Corp$1,200.00Mar 1
#1025Globex Inc$840.00Mar 3
#1026Initech$2,310.00Mar 5

Small Table

Add .zak-table-sm to tighten padding for dense layouts.

CommitAuthorTime
fix(forms): align select caretjun2m ago
feat(table): add striped variantmaya1h ago
docs(chip): close interactionzak3h ago
HTML
<table class="zak-table zak-table-sm">
  <thead>
    <tr><th>Commit</th><th>Author</th><th>Time</th></tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr><td>feat(table): add striped variant</td><td>maya</td><td>1h ago</td></tr>
  </tbody>
</table>

Dark Table

Add .zak-table-dark for inverted styling. Light foreground colors are applied automatically, so badges placed in a dark table should use solid variants.

ServiceRegionLatencyStatus
API Gatewayus-east-142msOperational
Object Storeeu-west-158msOperational
Queue Serviceap-south-1120msDegraded
Search Clusterus-west-2—Offline
HTML
<table class="zak-table zak-table-dark">
  <thead>
    <tr><th>Service</th><th>Region</th><th>Status</th></tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr><td>API Gateway</td><td>us-east-1</td><td>
      <span class="zak-badge zak-badge-success">Operational</span>
    </td></tr>
  </tbody>
</table>

Responsive Table

Wrap any table in .zak-table-wrapper to enable horizontal scrolling on small screens.

#ProductCategoryPriceStockSKUSupplierLast Updated
1Wireless MouseAccessories$29142WM-204Apex Supply Co.Mar 8
2USB-C HubAccessories$4967UH-118Northwind TradersMar 7
327" MonitorDisplays$32923MN-27QApex Supply Co.Mar 6
4Mechanical KeyboardInput$1190KB-87TElectro ImportersMar 4
HTML
<div class="zak-table-wrapper">
  <table class="zak-table">
    <thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Product</th><th>Price</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody><tr><td>1</td><td>Wireless Mouse</td><td>$29</td></tr></tbody>
  </table>
</div>

Head Variants

Send <thead> to dark mode with .zak-table-head-dark.

MetricValueChange
Active users8,240↑ 12.4%
New signups1,030↑ 8.1%
Churn3.2%↓ 0.4%
HTML
<table class="zak-table">
  <thead class="zak-table-head-dark">
    <tr><th>Metric</th><th>Value</th><th>Change</th></tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr><td>Active users</td><td>8,240</td><td>↑ 12.4%</td></tr>
  </tbody>
</table>

Table Footer and Caption

Add a <tfoot> for totals and a <caption> for context.

Q1 Revenue Summary
RegionQ1 RevenueTarget
North America$84,200$80,000
EMEA$61,750$65,000
APAC$48,900$50,000
Total$194,850$195,000
HTML
<table class="zak-table">
  <caption>Q1 Revenue Summary</caption>
  <thead>
    <tr><th>Region</th><th>Q1 Revenue</th></tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr><td>North America</td><td>$84,200</td></tr>
  </tbody>
  <tfoot>
    <tr><th>Total</th><th>$194,850</th></tr>
  </tfoot>
</table>

CSS Classes Reference

Class Description
.zak-tableBase table styles with clean cell spacing
.zak-table-stripedAlternating row backgrounds
.zak-table-hoverRow highlight on hover
.zak-table-borderedBorders between all cells
.zak-table-smCompact padding for dense data
.zak-table-darkInverted (dark) table colors
.zak-table-head-darkDark header only
.zak-table-wrapperResponsive horizontal-scroll container

Accessibility

  • Use real <table>, <thead>, <tbody>, and <th> semantics — never build tables from grids.
  • Associate each <th> with its column data, and use scope="col" / scope="row" where rows have headers.
  • Provide a <caption> summarizing the table content for screen reader users.
  • Do not rely on color alone (stripes, dark variant) — keep badges and text labels alongside any color hint.
  • For interactive rows (click to open a record), add a keyboard-reachable mechanism and aria-current on the active row.
